Carlsbro Carlsbro "Alu" series 16 products » About Carlsbro "Alu" series The Carlsbro Effects Series, introduced in 1977 , is a unified range of British analog pedals developed for live and studio use. The lineup includes both compact treadle-style units and larger, mains-powered enclosures used for modulation, delay, and equalization effects. All pedals feature footswitch activation and are housed in durable metal casings with control layouts designed for practical, onstage use. The series covers a wide spectrum of effects: Distortion and Dynamics : Suzz , Sustain Modulation : Phase 1 , Phase 2 , Chorus , Flanger Time-Based Effects : Echo , A.D.T. (Automatic Double Tracking) Filtering and Expression : Wah-Wah Equalization : EQ 6 , EQ 10 Several full-size models, including the Chorus , Flanger , Echo , and A.D.T. , are powered via mains supply.  The 1977 Carlsbro Effects Series is defined by its consistent visual identity, solid construction, and analog circuitry tuned for musical performance.
